card.name: Small words inside cautionary label sentences
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, in, have, more, not, unless) in the middle of a warning or qualifying clause in drug labels, and sometimes a digit inside a trial ID number. It marks the point where the sentence is about to state a condition or limit.

modes.label: Linking words in caveats
modes.description: Short words like in, the, more, not or unless in the middle of a conditional or cautionary clause.
modes.example: An antagonist should not be administered<< in>> the absence of clinically significant respiratory depression.

modes.label: Digits in trial numbers
modes.description: A zero inside an NCT clinical trial registry number.
